fr.label: Chef·fe de projet
fr.description: Rapports d'avancement, risques, plannings, comités de pilotage et bilans de projet.

en.label: Project manager
en.description: Status reports, risks, schedules, steering committees and project closure.

fr.text: L'état d'un projet (vert, orange, rouge) et les dates annoncées restent votre décision : l'agent propose, avec ses raisons.

en.text: A project's status (green, amber, red) and the dates announced remain your decision: the agent proposes, with its reasons.

guardrails.agent: Never state a project status, a go-live date or a budget forecast as decided: propose it, give the facts from the documents that support it, and list it under « Points to confirm ».

fr.text: Les dates, budgets, avancements et responsables viennent des documents ; ce qui manque reste « à définir ».

en.text: Dates, budgets, progress and owners come from the documents; what is missing stays « to be defined ».

guardrails.agent: Copy every date, amount, percentage of progress and owner exactly from the documents or the request; when one is missing write « [à définir] ». Show how any computed figure (variance, remaining budget, delay in days) was calculated.

fr.text: Un écart entre deux documents (planning et compte rendu, budget et facture) est signalé, jamais arrangé en silence.

en.text: A gap between two documents (schedule and minutes, budget and invoice) is flagged, never quietly smoothed over.

guardrails.agent: When two documents disagree on a date, an amount, a scope or an owner, show both versions with their source and flag the gap; never pick one silently.

fr.text: Les appréciations sur les personnes (performance, conflits) n'ont pas leur place dans un rapport de projet ; elles relèvent des RH, dans un projet « Confidentiel ».

en.text: Judgements on people (performance, conflicts) do not belong in a project report; they belong to HR, in a « Confidential » project.

guardrails.agent: Describe issues by facts, tasks and roles, never by judging a named person's performance or behaviour; if the documents contain such judgements, leave them out and tell the person in one sentence that they belong in a confidential HR project.

fr.label: Rapport d'avancement
fr.description: Météo du projet pour la direction
fr.hint: Quel projet, quelle période ? Ex. « Rapport d'avancement du projet ERP, octobre 2026, pour le comité »
fr.attach: Le planning à jour, le suivi budgétaire, les derniers comptes rendus, le registre des risques
fr.produces: Un rapport : météo proposée, jalons atteints et à venir, budget consommé, risques et décisions attendues
checks: Les chiffres du budget et leur calcul
Les décisions demandées à la direction

en.label: Status report
en.hint: Which project, which period? E.g. “Status report of the ERP project, October 2026, for the committee”
en.attach: The updated schedule, the budget follow-up, the latest minutes, the risk register
en.produces: A report: proposed status, milestones reached and ahead, budget spent, risks and decisions needed
checks: The budget figures and their calculation

templates.mission:
Write the status report of a project for the period requested. What the person asked for: {subject}

Open with a proposed status (green / amber / red) for scope, schedule and budget, each justified in one line from the documents. Compare planned and actual milestone dates in a table, with the delay in days. Show budget spent versus budget approved with the calculation. End with the top risks and the decisions management is asked to take, each with a deadline.

fr.label: Registre des risques
fr.hint: Quel projet ? Ex. « Registre des risques du déménagement de l'entrepôt, depuis l'atelier du 10.11 »
fr.attach: Les notes d'atelier risques, les comptes rendus, le planning, l'ancien registre s'il existe
fr.produces: Un tableau Excel : risque, cause, impact, probabilité, gravité, score, mesure, responsable, échéance, source
checks: Les responsables et échéances des mesures

en.label: Risk register
en.hint: Which project? E.g. “Risk register of the warehouse move, from the workshop of 10.11”
en.attach: The risk workshop notes, the minutes, the schedule, the previous register if any
en.produces: An Excel table: risk, cause, impact, likelihood, severity, score, action, owner, deadline, source
checks: Owners and deadlines of the actions

templates.mission:
Build the risk register of a project from the documents attached. What the person asked for: {subject}

Columns: N°, Risque, Cause, Impact, Probabilité (1-4), Gravité (1-4), Score, Mesure, Responsable, Échéance, Statut, Source, À vérifier. Score = Probabilité × Gravité, computed. Use only the ratings the documents give; when a rating is missing leave it empty and mark the row « À vérifier ». Sort by score, highest first, and merge risks that the documents describe twice, naming both sources.

fr.label: Charte de projet
fr.hint: Quel projet, qui le commande ? Ex. « Charte du projet de nouveau site web, mandant : la direction »
fr.attach: La demande ou l'idée de projet, le budget alloué, les notes de cadrage, les offres reçues
fr.produces: Une charte : contexte, objectifs mesurables, périmètre (inclus, exclu), jalons, budget, rôles, risques majeurs
checks: Le mandant, le chef de projet et le budget

en.label: Project charter
en.hint: Which project, who commissions it? E.g. “Charter of the new website project, sponsor: management”
en.attach: The project request or idea, the budget allocated, the framing notes, the quotes received
en.produces: A charter: context, measurable objectives, scope (in, out), milestones, budget, roles, main risks
checks: The objectives and how they are measured
The sponsor, the project manager and the budget

templates.mission:
Write the charter of a project. What the person asked for: {subject}

State the context and the problem in five lines, then objectives that can be measured, each with its indicator. Separate what is in scope from what is explicitly out of scope. List the main milestones, the budget and its source, and the roles (sponsor, project manager, team, steering committee) as named in the documents. Any objective, date or role the documents do not give stays « [à définir] ».

fr.label: Planning ou rétroplanning
fr.hint: Quelle échéance finale ? Ex. « Rétroplanning de l'ouverture de la succursale au 01.03.2027 »
fr.attach: La date cible, la liste des tâches ou les notes de réunion, les délais des fournisseurs
fr.produces: Un planning par phase : tâches, responsables, durées, dates, dépendances et chemin critique

en.label: Schedule or backward plan
en.hint: Which final deadline? E.g. “Backward plan for opening the branch on 01.03.2027”
en.attach: The target date, the task list or meeting notes, the suppliers' lead times
en.produces: A schedule by phase: tasks, owners, durations, dates, dependencies and critical path

templates.mission:
Build the schedule of a project; when a final deadline is given, plan backwards from it. What the person asked for: {subject}

Group tasks by phase, each with owner, duration, start and end date, and the tasks it depends on. Take lead times from the documents and count in working days unless they say otherwise. Name the critical path and the slack left before the deadline. When the dates cannot fit, say by how many days and which tasks cause it, rather than compressing durations.

fr.label: Compte rendu de comité de pilotage
fr.hint: Quel comité, quelle date ? Ex. « Compte rendu du COPIL du 12.11.2026, depuis mes notes »
fr.attach: Vos notes ou la transcription, la présentation montrée, le rapport d'avancement
fr.produces: Un compte rendu : présences, état présenté, décisions numérotées, arbitrages, actions avec responsables
checks: La formulation des décisions et arbitrages
Les responsables et échéances des actions
Les chiffres repris de la présentation

en.label: Steering committee minutes
en.description: Decisions and trade-offs of the committee
en.hint: Which committee, which date? E.g. “Minutes of the steering committee of 12.11.2026, from my notes”
en.attach: Your notes or the transcript, the slides shown, the status report
en.produces: Minutes: attendance, status presented, numbered decisions, trade-offs, actions with owners
checks: The wording of decisions and trade-offs
Owners and deadlines of the actions
The figures taken from the slides

templates.mission:
Write the minutes of a project steering committee. What the person asked for: {subject}

Record the status presented (scope, schedule, budget) with the figures as given, then each item discussed. Number the decisions (D1, D2…) and state each trade-off with what was given up. Gather every action in a final table (action, owner, deadline). When the notes and the attached report disagree on a figure or a date, show both and flag it.

fr.label: Plan de communication du projet
fr.hint: Quel projet, quels publics ? Ex. « Plan de communication du changement de logiciel de caisse, collaborateurs et clients »
fr.attach: La charte ou le planning du projet, la liste des parties prenantes, les canaux disponibles
fr.produces: Un plan : publics, messages clés, canal, émetteur, date, et un calendrier récapitulatif

en.label: Project communication plan
en.hint: Which project, which audiences? E.g. “Communication plan for the new till software, staff and customers”
en.attach: The project charter or schedule, the list of stakeholders, the channels available
en.produces: A plan: audiences, key messages, channel, sender, date, and a summary calendar

templates.mission:
Write the communication plan of a project. What the person asked for: {subject}

List the audiences found in the documents with what each needs to know and what the project needs from them. For each communication give the message in one sentence, channel, sender, date and the milestone it is tied to. Use only channels and senders named in the documents or the memory. End with a calendar table in date order.

fr.label: Analyse d'une demande de changement
fr.hint: Quelle demande ? Ex. « Le client veut ajouter un module de réservation : impact sur le projet »
fr.attach: La demande de changement, la charte ou le contrat, le planning et le budget actuels, l'offre du fournisseur
fr.produces: Une note de décision : la demande, son impact sur délai, coût et périmètre, les options et une recommandation

en.label: Change request analysis
en.hint: Which request? E.g. “The client wants a booking module added: impact on the project”
en.attach: The change request, the charter or contract, the current schedule and budget, the supplier's quote
en.produces: A decision note: the request, its impact on time, cost and scope, the options and a recommendation

templates.mission:
Analyse a change request for the decision-maker. What the person asked for: {subject}

Restate the request in three lines, then its impact on schedule (days, milestones moved), cost (amounts from the quotes, with the calculation) and scope. Check whether the charter or contract already covers it. Give two or three options (accept, defer, refuse or reduce), each with its consequence, then a proposed recommendation marked as a proposal.

fr.label: Bilan de fin de projet
fr.hint: Quel projet ? Ex. « Bilan du projet de migration de la messagerie, terminé fin octobre »
fr.attach: La charte de départ, le dernier rapport d'avancement, le budget final, les retours de l'équipe
fr.produces: Un bilan : objectifs atteints ou non, écarts de délai et de coût, leçons apprises, points ouverts à transmettre
checks: Les points ouverts et leur repreneur

en.label: Project closure report
en.hint: Which project? E.g. “Closure report of the e-mail migration project, finished end of October”
en.attach: The initial charter, the last status report, the final budget, the team's feedback
en.produces: A report: objectives met or not, schedule and cost variances, lessons learned, open points to hand over
checks: Open points and who takes them over

templates.mission:
Write the closure report of a project. What the person asked for: {subject}

Compare each objective of the charter with the result reported, saying met, partly met or not met, with the evidence. Compute schedule and cost variances against the initial plan, showing the calculation. Turn the team's feedback into lessons learned worded as what to keep and what to change. List the open points to hand over, each with a proposed owner from the documents.

fr.title: Méthode et gouvernance des projets
fr.description: Comment vos projets sont conduits : phases, instances, qui décide quoi, seuils d'escalade — à compléter par l'équipe.
fr.body:
Cette note dit à l'agent comment vos projets sont gouvernés. Remplacez chaque blanc par votre pratique.

- Méthode utilisée : [À compléter : ex. phases classiques, agile, mixte]
- Phases et jalons standard : [À compléter : ex. cadrage, conception, réalisation, mise en service, clôture]
- Comité de pilotage (rythme, membres par fonction) : [À compléter]
- Qui approuve un changement de périmètre, de budget, de date : [À compléter]
- Seuil d'escalade à la direction : [À compléter : ex. retard de plus de 10 jours ouvrables ou dépassement de CHF 5'000.00]
